title: Configure openwebui
description: Configure the Open WebUI + Ollama module

host.title: Host name
host.description: Fully qualified domain name under which Open WebUI is published.

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate for the host name.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all HTTP requests to HTTPS.

webui_name.title: Interface name
webui_name.description: Display name shown in the Open WebUI interface (WEBUI_NAME).

enable_signup.title: Allow self-registration
enable_signup.description: Let visitors create their own account (ENABLE_SIGNUP). The very first account always becomes the administrator. Turn off once your users exist.

default_user_role.title: Default role for new accounts
default_user_role.description: Role assigned to newly registered users (DEFAULT_USER_ROLE). 'pending' requires admin approval before login.

enable_openai_api.title: Enable OpenAI-compatible API
enable_openai_api.description: Also allow external OpenAI-compatible endpoints in addition to the bundled Ollama (ENABLE_OPENAI_API). Keep off for a self-contained, local-only setup.

ollama_keep_alive.title: Model keep-alive
ollama_keep_alive.description: How long Ollama keeps a model loaded in memory after the last request (OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE), e.g. 5m, 1h, or -1 to keep loaded.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: TZ database name for scheduling and log timestamps, e.g. Europe/Berlin.
